card.name: Punctuation after children-under-age phrases
card.fires_on: The spot right after a "children under 12" style phrase, usually the colon or space before the instruction. Also fires on small words after "as directed by" and at the start of a contact line after a manufacturer address.

modes.label: After children under age
modes.description: The colon or gap right after "Children under 12" or "under 12 years", before the child instruction.
modes.example: Children under 12<<:>> use half the adult dose.

modes.label: After directed-by phrase
modes.description: A small word or noun following "directed by" or "consult a" in label directions.
modes.example: or as directed by<< a>> licensed healthcare practitioner. Do not administer to

modes.label: After manufacturer address
modes.description: The word starting the contact sentence after a company address and zip code.
modes.example: Parsippany, NJ 07054<< For>> more information, contact Teva at
